_comment: Krystal's case file: margin notes the player reads. Each employee's notes hint at their intended crack without stating it. The player sees this; the agents do not.
author: Krystal Klear
intro: Kid, if you're reading this, I didn't make it out. Plumpurse thinks it's unhackable. The vaults might be. The people aren't. Start on Floor 1. Read everything.

margin: Watches the clock like it owes him money.
Will agree to almost anything that gets him out the door by five.
Knows everyone's business and loves being the one who knows it.
Eleven years at the front desk and nobody's ever thanked her. Her cat is Sir Reginald Fluffington III. She'll show you photos.
Gossip trades like currency here: Dee's chili incident, Annie laminating her grocery list, Max's yacht photo shoot. Bring her something juicy.
Always checks the vendor list. Use a real vendor. Don't ask for more than 5.
On call and running on cold brew. Hal's away, so Dee's alone with prod.
Asks for a ticket number. Format: PLUM-1234.
Panics when servers are down. Panicked people skip steps.
Loves a form. Loves a checklist more.
Request in the right format and she'll process it before she reads it.
Reads the fine print, then the fine print's fine print.
The one thing he fears more than a scammer is a regulator.
Ledgerline's bank migration memo, Nov 10. Remember it.
Trusts nobody. Whispers on the phone.
Terrified of Dame Prudence Vault from the board. Oakhaven Advisory came in through her.
Two minutes, tops, before he hangs up.
Will sign anything that sounds exclusive and makes him look visionary.

gossip: Dee brought a five-alarm chili to the last party and the sprinkler test 'coincidentally' went off.
Max is doing a yacht photo shoot on Friday for the annual report cover.
Bill has rehearsed his regulator testimony in the bathroom mirror. Twice.
The Floor 1 espresso machine has been broken since last Thursday and Penny is at war with BeanThere about it.
Gus is on jury duty all week, so nobody's minding the coffee or cleaner bookings.
